model_output.rationale: 835 denies all lines CO-22 with claim-level MOA MA04. 271 for DOS shows EB*R identifying Novitas Medicare Part B FFS with message "PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER" — Medicare is primary. Claim was billed to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary (SBR P). MA04 = primary adjudication data missing; per reference, correct_and_resubmit to same payer after obtaining primary's EOB. Never resubmit_other_payer on MA04.

root_cause.explanation: Claim filed to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary, but 271 EB*R confirms Medicare Part B (Novitas) is primary payer. Patient age 85. MA04: primary payer adjudication data not supplied on the secondary claim.

next_action.detail: Bill Medicare Part B (Novitas, payer ID 1846349352) as primary first. Then resubmit to Delaware Valley Mutual as secondary (SBR01=S) with Medicare's SBR/AMT/CAS and line SVD/CAS. CLM05-3=7, REF*F8=2621080619623.

evidence.fact: All lines denied CO-22; claim-level MOA MA04 (secondary payment cannot be considered without primary payer identity).
EB*R identifies Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS; payer message PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER.
Claim filed with payer responsibility P (primary) to Delaware Valley Mutual — COB order as billed was wrong.
Payer claim control number 2621080619623 for REF*F8 on corrected resubmission.

citations.rule: MA04 → correct_and_resubmit to the same payer. Completeness defect, not a routing problem; never resubmit_other_payer.
CARC 22, 109 (not MA04) → resubmit_other_payer; MA04 overrides to correct_and_resubmit.
Adjudicated + billed content wrong/incomplete → corrected claim CLM05-3=7 with REF*F8 = CLP07 payer control number.
